request.prompt: Flat 2D anime illustration of a bishōnen male Korean language teacher named Daehan. Long silver-white hair, violet eyes, wearing a black gat (traditional Korean hat) with a gold ornamental band and red tassels, a plain black durumagi hanbok, white inner collar, and black gloves. 16:9 widescreen classroom scene. Daehan's BODY stays on the RIGHT side of the frame — torso occupying only the right ~22%, his left shoulder near horizontal 78%. His right ARM extends leftward at shoulder height with the gloved index finger pointing toward the left-center of the empty chalkboard — only the outstretched arm crosses into the board zone; the rest of his body stays right. Playful curious teacher expression, small smile, looking toward the camera. His left hand holds a small tied paper scroll at his hip. LEFT 78% of the frame is a dark green empty chalkboard with a thin wooden frame and a narrow wooden chalk tray at the bottom. The chalkboard surface is ABSOLUTELY EMPTY — no text, no Korean characters, no chalk marks, no numbers, no writing. Flat anime shading, crisp line-art.
